low.label: Low risk
low.description: Usually cosmetic or slow-spreading. Monitor and use simple cultural fixes.

moderate.label: Moderate risk
moderate.description: Can reduce yield if ignored. Act within the week.

high.label: High risk
high.description: Spreads fast or causes heavy losses. Act today.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: No cure once infected. Contain it immediately and contact your agriculture officer.

any_symptoms.text: Do you see any spots, yellow patches, powder or dead areas anywhere on the leaf?
any_symptoms.help: Look at both sides of the leaf in good light.

target_rings.text: Do the brown spots have rings inside them, like a target or bull's-eye?
target_rings.help: Concentric rings are typical of early blight and target spot.

white_growth_underside.text: In the morning or after rain, is there white, fuzzy growth on the underside of the leaf at the edge of the dark patches?
white_growth_underside.help: Turn the leaf over. Late blight produces a white downy mould at lesion edges in humid weather.

olive_velvet_underside.text: Are there olive-green to brown velvety patches under the leaf, below pale yellow spots on top?
olive_velvet_underside.help: This is the classic sign of tomato leaf mould, common in humid greenhouses.

tiny_spots_grey_centre.text: Are there many small round spots (2-3 mm) with grey-white centres and dark borders, starting on the lowest leaves?
tiny_spots_grey_centre.help: Use a magnifier: tiny black dots in the centre point to Septoria leaf spot.

greasy_spots_halo.text: Are the spots small, dark and greasy or water-soaked looking, sometimes with a yellow halo, making the leaf look ragged?
greasy_spots_halo.help: Bacterial spots often look wet and the dead centres can fall out, leaving holes.

webbing_mites.text: Can you see fine silk webbing or tiny moving dots under the leaf, with fine pale speckling on top?
webbing_mites.help: Tap the leaf over white paper: moving specks are spider mites.

curled_yellow_young_leaves.text: Are the young leaves small, cupped upward with yellow edges, and is the plant stunted and bushy?
curled_yellow_young_leaves.help: Check the top of the plant. Whiteflies are often present.

mosaic_pattern.text: Do the leaves show a light-green and dark-green mottled (mosaic) pattern, sometimes fern-like or distorted?
mosaic_pattern.help: Mosaic viruses cause patchy colour rather than distinct spots.

powdery_rubs_off.text: Is there white, flour-like powder on the leaf that rubs off with a finger?
powdery_rubs_off.help: Powdery mildew sits on the surface and wipes away.

orange_pustules.text: Are there raised, rusty orange-brown bumps that leave powder on your finger?
orange_pustules.help: Rust pustules release powdery spores when rubbed.

cigar_lesions.text: Are the corn lesions long and cigar-shaped (about 2-15 cm), grey-green to tan, and not boxed in by the leaf veins?
cigar_lesions.help: Northern leaf blight lesions are long ovals; gray leaf spot lesions are narrow rectangles limited by veins.

rectangular_vein_limited.text: Are the corn lesions narrow rectangles with straight sides that stop at the leaf veins?
rectangular_vein_limited.help: Hold the leaf against the light: gray leaf spot lesions run parallel between veins.

olive_feathery_spots.text: Are there olive-green to black velvety spots with feathery, blurred edges on the apple leaf?
olive_feathery_spots.help: Apple scab spots look velvety and have no sharp border.

purple_border_frogeye.text: Are there round spots with a purple border and a tan centre ("frog-eye" spots)?
purple_border_frogeye.help: Typical of apple black rot (frog-eye leaf spot).

water_soaked_spreading.text: Are there dark, water-soaked patches that grow quickly (within days), often with a pale green border?
water_soaked_spreading.help: Late blight lesions spread fast in cool, wet weather and cross leaf veins.

tiger_stripes.text: Do grape leaves show yellow or red stripes between the veins with dry brown centres ("tiger stripes")?
tiger_stripes.help: Typical foliar sign of Esca (black measles).
